## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Madrid, Spain. It starts at 61 Calle de Serrano.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Enjoy an interactive adventure at Sweet Space, a unique space full of innovative experiences and plenty of fun.
>
> Bringing together art and new digital trends, Sweet Space arrives in Madrid as the first location on a tour across Europe.
>
> In the world of Sweet Space, everything is designed to create an inclusive and diverse environment, a human connection through the universal power of taste.
>
> Enter this magic environment and take a tour of themed rooms with interactive exhibits that transform concepts and dreams into spaces that inspire imagination, creativity and of course... a touch of sweetness!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €19.12. It was rated 4.2 out of 5 from 221 ratings and 134 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
